title: Indian roads are INSANE...
description:
Every time you step out, India’s roads feel like a warzone. Oversized Thars zooming recklessly for Instagram reels, overloaded e-rickshaws crawling into fast lanes, and bikers weaving through traffic without helmets chaos has become the rule, not the exception.

Add to that poor road design, zero lane discipline, and a police system that looks the other way, and you have the perfect recipe for accidents.

In this video, we expose why Indian roads are among the most dangerous in the world and how drivers themselves are making it worse every single day.
